note: #[route] rejects a Path<T> extractor that can never deserialize the route's own path parameters with a compile error spanned on the Path type: a tuple with fewer elements than the route's parameters, a primitive scalar on a route with two or more parameters, and a same-file deny_unknown_fields struct with no field for one of the route's parameters. Extractors that read more parameters than the route declares (an app nested under a parameterised prefix) stay accepted
